supersedes.does_not_bind_reason: shop-01 closed before the v3 file existed and its record was frozen unvalidated (E-0201, E-0204). v3.2 changes nothing about that ruling.
supersedes.why_frozen_records_are_unaffected: Dispatch is per file on the schema each declares, so a v3 protocol, manifest and record never meet a v3.2 branch. The four validated v3 records at run-22, run-23, run-24 and run-25 keep validating byte-identical under review-protocol-v3.json, which is not edited.

evidence_surface.declared_by_note: v2 fixed one surface in the protocol and a row cell could not be validated against it. Here the protocol names the kinds it recognises and the manifest of each cell declares which one that cell uses, the source materials with their digests, and the locator convention.

SELECTED_READING_TEXT_LAYER.locator_form: the block id as the selected reading writes it

locator_convention_keys.first_row_index: 0_OR_1, the index the first row carries
locator_convention_keys.csv_header_is_a_row: TRUE_OR_FALSE, whether a CSV header line is counted as a row

STRUCTURED_ROWS.locator_convention_note: shop-01's producer counted physical lines from 1 with the CSV header as line 1 and its review task counted data rows from 0 with the header excluded; neither was declared anywhere, and thirteen of fifteen derivations read as unresolvable under the convention the reviewer used (E-0204). A cell that declares neither knob is refused.

IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET.locator_form: the block id as the selected reading writes it
IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET.witness_is_note: A claim is one sentence-level assertion the answer file makes, with the reading blocks it cites. Support is judged against the cited block and not the article around it, unchanged from the graph surfaces.
IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET.witness_counts_are_comparable_across_sur: Unlike graph records, two answers stating the same fact carry two claim ids and have no shared identity, so the judge-each-distinct-witness-once economy of source_support_unit_note does not transfer. Only coverage of the authored elements is comparable across surfaces.
IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET.read_instead_of_a_query_result_note: The answer surface has no ledger, no replay receipt, no query binding and no trace. The material the reviewer opens is the producer's answer file, whose grammar is paper-v4/experiment-v4/baseline-01/answer-file-schema.json.
IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET.questions_are_visible_to_the_producer_no: This is a baseline, not a Malleus cell. The baseline sees the questions and every graph producer was denied them, so the comparison is tilted toward the baseline on purpose, which is what makes it a price rather than a contest.

stage_identities.declared_per_surface_kind_note: v3 fixed one set for every surface, and review.py refused a manifest whose keys differed. An answer set has no ledger, no replay receipt and no query binding, so its identities are a different set and not a subset with holes. Stage identities are therefore declared per kind here, which is the shape this protocol already used twice: fixed_identities.required_keys_by_surface_kind and review_materials.required.

question_ids.note: v2 pinned CQ-01 to CQ-04 and refused any other cell's questions. Here the manifest declares the cell's question ids and they must equal, in order, the ids of the competency question file the manifest binds by digest.

judgments.source_support_unit_note: Run-21 judged 490 rows over 182 witnesses. Support is judged once per distinct witness and the rows that share a witness reference that judgement, so the same fact is never judged twice with two outcomes. On IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET the unit is one cited claim and no two claims share an identity, so the economy does not apply there and the witness count is not comparable across surfaces.

row_resolution_definitions.VALUE_MATCHES_ROW: the record's value on that path equals the value in the field the locator names
row_resolution_definitions.VALUE_DERIVED_FROM_ROW: the value follows from the field by a stated transformation: an identifier prefix, a constant from a coded field, a unit attached to a bare number
row_resolution_definitions.VALUE_DIFFERS_FROM_ROW: the locator resolves and the value neither equals the field nor follows from it by a stated transformation
row_resolution_definitions.LOCATOR_NOT_RESOLVABLE: the locator does not name a declared source, or the row is outside the file under the declared convention, or the field is absent from that row

judgments.row_resolution_note: VALUE_DERIVED_FROM_ROW is added because shop-01's task read equality where the grammar means derivation: four endpoint identifiers minted by prefixing a row value and a relation type taken from a coded field can never equal their field, and the Small Shop fixture's own hand-written plan derives ORDER_CONTAINS_UNIT the same way, so the fixture would have failed its own review (E-0204). VALUE_DIFFERS_FROM_ROW is kept from the shop-01 task because without it a locator that resolves to an unfaithful value has no token.
judgments.locator_not_resolvable_rule: A witness whose resolution is LOCATOR_NOT_RESOLVABLE carries source_support NOT_EVALUABLE, never PARTIAL and never UNSUPPORTED, and records the reason in its rationale. Two sessions labelled the same unresolvable locator PARTIAL and UNSUPPORTED in one cell; the label for a mechanical fact is a rule, not a judgement (E-0204).

coverage_absent_reason_definitions.NOT_MODELLED: the accepted contract declares no type and no slot that could carry the element
coverage_absent_reason_definitions.NOT_CAPTURED: the accepted contract has a type or slot for the element and no record or field carries it and no gap declares it
coverage_absent_reason_definitions.WITHHELD_STATEMENT: the element survives only inside a retained statement the graph binds by locator and digest
coverage_absent_reason_definitions.UNREACHED_RECORD: a record carries the element and no query case returns it
coverage_absent_reason_definitions.NOT_IN_SOURCE: the reading does not state the element
coverage_absent_reason_definitions.LOCATOR_NOT_RESOLVABLE: the locator does not resolve under the declared convention

judgments.coverage_absent_reasons_note: v3's five had no word for plain omission, so NOT_MODELLED carried both 'the ontology had no place for this' and 'the contract had a place and this record left it unset', and an absence could not be diagnosed from its token. The external review named that, and design/PAPER_EVALUATION_V32_PROPOSAL.md priced the three ways to fix it. NOT_CAPTURED is the sixth, and it is the reviewer's to choose: paper-v4/evaluation-v4/absence-recoding-2026-09-12.json shows that the derivation decides the subject-slot family from artifacts and leaves thirteen of forty-one absences to a judgement, so the code is reviewer-facing and not validator-derived.
judgments.coverage_absent_reasons_on_the_answer_su: A prose answer has no slot and no record, so NOT_CAPTURED reads there as 'the answer set does not state it and declares no NO_ANSWER_IN_SOURCE for it'. UNREACHED_RECORD and LOCATOR_NOT_RESOLVABLE do not arise on that surface.
judgments.coverage_rule: For each item of the question's required_semantics, in the question file's order, the reviewer names the row index of a row whose witness is SUPPORTED, or whose resolution is VALUE_DERIVED_FROM_ROW, and whose projected fields carry that item; or names one absent reason from the list above and writes why.
judgments.question_responsiveness_derivation: COVERED when every required semantic names a row; NONE when none does; PARTIAL otherwise, with the absent items as the record of what is missing. The record states the label and the validator refuses a label its derivation does not produce.
judgments.question_responsiveness_note: v2's chosen label folded a coverage failure, a withheld statement, an unreachable record, a superset binding and an unjoined answer into one word whose threshold each session set for itself; fourteen of twenty-eight labels were PARTIAL for five different reasons, and CQ-03's label did not reproduce under a blind re-judgement (E-0191). The reviewer's judgement moves to the unit that reproduced: one row against one thing.
judgments.assembly_not_applicable_note: A prose answer always assembles, so the descriptor would be constant and uninformative, and a constant token in a comparison table reads as a grade, which assembly_is forbids. The answer surface declares it not applicable, the way resolution is already absent on the text layer, rather than taking a fourth descriptor.
judgments.assembly_note: Recorded per question and never an input to any label. It reports what run-21's CQ-04 PARTIAL was reporting, that the answer is two claim rows nothing joins, without lowering a label for an exclusion the protocol makes on purpose.

NOT_IN_SOURCE.reads: a COVERED here is a fabrication finding

EXCLUDED_SURFACE.reads: the answer is only in a figure or a table, which the question file's scope excludes

PARAPHRASE.reads: a difference is a reliability finding

controls.note: Every question of the four-question set has its answer in the paper, so nothing measured the false-positive side. A control is reviewed like any other question; only its outcome is read differently, and by a person.

checklist.note: This protocol is the rulebook; this section is how each rule is verified. One entry per check the review performs, each naming what passes it, which artifact is read, whether the validator settles it mechanically or the reviewer settles it by judgement, and the field the outcome lands in. A reviewer works the list in order and reports a tick per entry beside the record; the record's own key set is exact and carries no tick.

verifiers.VALIDATOR: paper-v4/evaluation-v4/review.py settles it mechanically and refuses when it fails. It never chooses, changes or aggregates a judgement.
verifiers.REVIEWER: the preliminary reviewer settles it by reading the cited evidence, and the validator checks only that the token written is one the protocol declares.

checks.name: Every bound input is the bytes that were supplied
checks.passes_when: Each material's sha256 equals the digest of the bytes handed to the validator, the record binds the manifest's digest in inputs.review_input_manifest_sha256, and the manifest binds the protocol's. Any difference refuses before a single judgement is read.

checks.name: The identities present are the ones this surface kind declares
checks.passes_when: fixed_identities and stage_identities carry exactly the key sets required_keys_by_surface_kind names for the kind the manifest declares: seven ledger-side keys on a graph surface, three and no ledger head on the answer surface. A key more or fewer refuses.

checks.name: Every locator resolves on the declared surface
checks.passes_when: On SELECTED_READING_TEXT_LAYER and IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET every cited locator is a block id the selected reading declares. On STRUCTURED_ROWS the locator opens in the source it names, at the row the declared convention numbers, and one that does not resolve is LOCATOR_NOT_RESOLVABLE and NOT_EVALUABLE by rule.
reads: selected reading or the declared source files

checks.name: Support is judged once per distinct witness, against the cited evidence only
checks.passes_when: review.witnesses judges every returned witness exactly once and no other; each carries one source_support token and cites the surface at least once. On IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET a witness cites every block its own claim cites, so support rests on the cited block and not on the article around it.

checks.name: Whether the cited evidence supports the witness
checks.passes_when: The reviewer opens the cited block or row and chooses SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, UNSUPPORTED or NOT_EVALUABLE, and writes the reason in their own words. The validator checks that the token is one of the four and never which one it is.

checks.name: Every required element names a row or carries one absence code
checks.passes_when: coverage names the question's required_semantics in the question file's order, and each entry either names the row_index of a row whose witness is SUPPORTED, or whose resolution is VALUE_DERIVED_FROM_ROW, or carries exactly one absent_reason from this protocol's six with a note. Naming both, or neither, refuses.

checks.name: Which row carries a required element, or why none does
checks.passes_when: For each required semantic the reviewer either names the row that carries it, or picks the one absence code that states why it is absent and writes why. NOT_CAPTURED is the code for an element the surface could carry and does not; NOT_MODELLED is only for a surface whose contract has no type and no slot for it.

checks.name: The question label is derived, never chosen
checks.passes_when: question_responsiveness equals what the derivation from coverage produces: COVERED when every required semantic names a row, NONE when none does, PARTIAL otherwise. A stated label the derivation does not produce refuses.

checks.name: Assembly is a descriptor and never a grade
checks.passes_when: assembly is one of ONE_ROW, LINKED_ROWS or UNLINKED_ROWS on a graph surface and NOT_APPLICABLE on IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET, and is never an input to any label the validator derives.

checks.name: Each control's outcome is compared with the expected one and refuses nothing
checks.passes_when: For every question the competency file marks with an expected_outcome, the derived label is compared with NONE, or with the named question's label for a PARAPHRASE, and each comparison is reported as a finding. No control outcome refuses a record and none changes a judgement.

checks.name: The producer's answer text does not reproduce the reading
checks.passes_when: No answer text and no claim statement shares a run of sixty characters, after whitespace is collapsed, with any block of the selected reading. The reading is private and the answer file is published, so a file that quotes it is refused before any review package is built.

checks.name: The reviewer's own words do not reproduce the reading
checks.passes_when: Every rationale and note is written in the reviewer's own words, copies no source passage beyond the locator and adds no numerical aggregate. Measured the same way as C-11: no run of sixty normalized characters shared with a reading block.

checks.name: Claim ids are unique and every claim cites a resolving block
checks.passes_when: Every claim_id in the answer file occurs exactly once, so no two claims share a witness identity and the witness count is a count of claims; and every block a claim cites is a block the selected reading declares. The per-question claim counts and the distinct-claim total equal the manifest's rows_per_question and witnesses_traced.

authorship.preliminary_evaluator_kind_note: v2 names CODEX_PRELIMINARY and every cell since run-09 recorded a deviation from it. Codex's tokens were exhausted on 2026-09-04 (handover/2026-09-04-overseer-takeover.md), so this protocol names the evaluator that actually runs. A cell using any other kind records a deviation, as before, and does not edit this file.

review_materials.answer_set_has_no_note: Not omitted for brevity: the baseline runs no admission, no ledger and no replay, so there is nothing to bind. A manifest on that surface that binds one of these is refused, because binding it would claim a stage the cell did not run.
review_materials.sources_are_materials_note: Every source the evidence surface declares is also a material, by the same path and the same digest. On the text layer and on the answer surface the selected reading is that material; on rows there is one per source file.
review_materials.additional_permitted_note: A cell may list more, a retained population plan per source among them. v2 fixed the list at seven and shop-01 had to bind four retained plans it could not name.

retained_from_v2.retained_capture: The review task has named the retained capture as an input since run-02 and the v1 manifest could not list it. It is a material.
retained_from_v2.query_trace_summary: The same debt for the per-witness trace. It is a material.

withheld_from_producer_exception.reason: The baseline is asked the questions directly; that is the condition being priced. Its manifest declares the visibility and the comparison is reported with it stated, never as a like-for-like contest. Every other item on the withheld list stays withheld from the baseline producer too.

record.witness_keys_note: resolution is carried on a STRUCTURED_ROWS cell and is absent on a SELECTED_READING_TEXT_LAYER cell and on an IN_CONTEXT_ANSWER_SET cell, where a block id is resolved by membership and there is no row to open. On the answer surface witness_key is the claim id and source_locators must include every block that claim cites, so support is judged against the cited block.

columns: elements reached of the authored total
absent_properties: no re-query of the same state
comparison.note: One model, one article, one prompt. This is not a retrieval baseline. A prose answer can cite a block and still be composed from the model's memory of the article, and no check here excludes that, so zero UNSUPPORTED on the baseline would not mean grounded.

validator.checks: identities, the declared surface and its locators, witness uniqueness and row coverage, the unresolvable-locator rule, the answer set's claims against the reading, coverage against required_semantics, and the derived responsiveness label
validator.never: chooses, changes or aggregates a judgment
